name: 90-130MHz 50W High-Power VCO Drone Jammer Module | Tactical Broadband Signal Blocker | Military-Grade Anti-Interference Device
description: Take Definitive Control: Neutralize Drone Threats & Secure Wireless Environments with 50W of Directed RF Power Facing unauthorized drones, illicit surveillance, or disruptive wireless signals? The ACASOM 90-130MHz 50W High-Power VCO Jammer Module is engineered to deliver decisive, wide-area signal denial. This tactical-grade device generates a powerful 50W RF blanket across a broad 90-130MHz spectrum, effectively disrupting control, telemetry, and data links for drones, WiFi networks, GPS tracking, and various communication bands. Built for demanding field operations, it provides a reliable and potent solution for perimeter defense, tactical enforcement, and high-stakes security scenarios. Core Tactical Advantages: High-Power Dominance: Outputs a commanding 50W (47dBm) of RF power, ensuring effective signal suppression over a significant operational radius and against stronger targets. Broad Spectrum Coverage: Tunable across the 90-130MHz range, making it versatile against a wide array of threats including drone control (ISM bands), GPS L2, VHF communications, and other susceptible signals within this spectrum. Operational Stability & Efficiency: Features excellent signal flatness (±0.5dB) and operates at up to 45% efficiency, ensuring consistent performance and better power management during extended missions. Ruggedized for Real-World Deployment: Housed in a robust aluminum shell and rated for operation from -30℃ to 85℃, this module is built to endure harsh environmental conditions. Customizable Power & Configuration: ACASOM supports custom power configurations to tailor the jamming strength and profile to your specific operational requirements and regulatory constraints. Technical Specifications: Parameter Specification Frequency Range 90 - 130 MHz Output Power 50 W (Typical @ 47 dBm) Operating Voltage 28 V DC Current Consumption ~3.6 A (@28V, 47dBm Output) Power Flatness ± 0.5 dB Overall Efficiency 45% (@47dBm) RF Connector SMA Female Power Input 5.5*2.0mm DC Jack (Default) or 15cm Wire Leads Operating Temperature -30℃ ~ +85℃ Storage Temperature -40℃ ~ +150℃ Dimensions (LxWxH) 128.5 x 53 x 17 mm Net Weight 0.26 kg Primary Operational Applications: Counter-Drone (C-UAS): Disrupt the control, navigation (GPS), and video transmission links of unauthorized drones. Wireless Security & Privacy: Create secure zones by blocking WiFi, Bluetooth, and specific VHF communication bands to prevent eavesdropping or unauthorized access. Tactical Law Enforcement & Military: Neutralize remote-controlled IED triggers, disrupt enemy communications, and secure perimeters during sensitive operations. Personal & VIP Protection: Provide mobile security by blocking tracking devices and wireless surveillance threats. Critical Deployment Notes: Power Supply Requirement: A stable and adequate 28V DC, 4.5A minimum power supply is mandatory for full-power operation. Under-powering will reduce effectiveness. Thermal Management is Crucial: At continuous full power, active cooling via a heatsink or fan is REQUIRED to prevent overheating and ensure module longevity and reliability. Safe Connection Protocol: Always connect the RF port to the compatible antenna system FIRST, before applying DC power, to prevent damage to the module. Package Includes: 1 x 90-130MHz 50W High-Power VCO Jammer Module Need a Custom Jamming Solution? ACASOM specializes in high-power RF and counter-surveillance technology. We offer customized designs for specific frequency bands, power outputs, and form factors. Contact our team to engineer a solution for your unique mission profile.
